verdict.rationale: BVNK docs show a dedicated Rules API (`POST /payment/v1/rules`) that automatically links a fiat virtual account to a crypto blockchain address, and webhooks that fire automated notifications on account events, both matching the 'rules trigger actions on events' pattern. However this is scoped narrowly to one payment-linking use case rather than a general-purpose rule engine covering arbitrary triggers/conditions/actions across the platform. Missing for 10: broader/generalized rule definitions beyond fiat-crypto linking, conditional logic support, and independent/hands-on corroboration of the rules feature working as described.
